title: Discussion & Meeting Vocabulary
sub: Verbs, adjectives and idioms for debating ideas and steering meetings.

cards.def:
To add to or develop someone else's idea
हिंदी: किसी के विचार को आगे बढ़ाना
examples: I'd like to build on Priya's point about retries.
Can I build on what Rahul just said about customer feedback?
We built on last year's plan instead of starting from scratch.
Her idea was good, and the team built on it to create something better.

cards.def:
To resist or disagree with a proposal respectfully
हिंदी: विनम्रता से असहमति जताना
examples: I'd push back slightly on the timeline; it looks tight.
Don't be afraid to push back if the deadline is unrealistic.
The client pushed back on the price, so we offered a smaller package.
My manager pushed back on my leave request because of the release.

cards.def:
To contribute an opinion to a discussion
हिंदी: अपनी राय रखना
examples: Could someone from security weigh in on this?
Before we decide, I'd like the finance team to weigh in.
Everyone weighed in on where to hold the team dinner.
Can you weigh in on this design before Friday?

cards.def:
To join a conversation with a comment
हिंदी: बातचीत में बीच में जुड़ना
examples: Feel free to chime in if I miss anything.
My colleague chimed in with a useful example.
Anyone can chime in during the open discussion.
When we talked about cricket, everyone wanted to chime in.

cards.def:
To start contributing, often by interrupting politely
हिंदी: बातचीत में कूदकर शामिल होना
examples: Sorry to jump in, but I have a quick clarification.
Can I jump in here with a quick update from the client?
New joiners are welcome to jump in with questions anytime.
He jumped in before I could finish my sentence.

cards.def:
To draw attention to a potential issue
हिंदी: संभावित समस्या की ओर ध्यान दिलाना
examples: I want to flag a risk with the current approach.
Please flag any expenses over five thousand rupees.
She flagged the missing signature before the contract was sent.
The tool flags suspicious logins automatically.

cards.def:
To bring a hidden issue to attention
हिंदी: छुपी समस्या को सामने लाना
examples: The review surfaced several gaps in our testing.
The survey surfaced some frustration with the new leave policy.
Please surface blockers early instead of waiting for the review.
One-on-one meetings help surface problems people won't mention in groups.

cards.def:
To extract details carefully from a complex situation
हिंदी: बारीकी से जानकारी निकालना
examples: We need to tease out the real requirement behind the request.
The doctor teased out the real cause of my headaches.
Good interviewers tease out the details behind a candidate's answers.
We need to tease out which part of the process causes the delay.

cards.def:
To analyse a complex idea in detail
हिंदी: जटिल विचार को खोलकर समझना
examples: Let's unpack what failure means in this context.
Let's unpack the feedback point by point.
There's a lot to unpack in this customer complaint.
Can you unpack what you mean by better communication?

cards.def:
To examine something in greater detail
हिंदी: गहराई में जाकर जाँचना
examples: Let's drill down into why latency spikes at noon.
The dashboard lets you drill down to a single customer.
Let's drill down into the reasons for the high returns.
When we drilled down, the problem was in one region only.

cards.def:
To look at the broader picture
हिंदी: बड़ी तस्वीर देखना
examples: Let's zoom out and ask what problem we're really solving.
If we zoom out, this quarter was actually quite good.
Zoom out for a moment and think about the user's whole day.
Zooming out helped us see that the bug was a design issue.

cards.def:
To reconsider a situation from a broader perspective
हिंदी: एक कदम पीछे हटकर सोचना
examples: Let's take a step back and look at the overall design.
When you feel stressed, take a step back and breathe.
We took a step back and realised the feature wasn't needed.
Let's take a step back before we argue about tools.

cards.def:
To argue an opposing view to test an idea
हिंदी: परीक्षण के लिए विरोधी पक्ष लेना
examples: Let me play devil's advocate and question the need for Kafka here.
I'll play devil's advocate: what if customers don't want this?
She often plays devil's advocate to test our plans.
Playing devil's advocate helped us find weak spots in the proposal.

cards.def:
To present the strongest version of an opposing argument
हिंदी: विपरीत तर्क का सबसे मज़बूत रूप रखना
examples: Let me steelman the case for keeping the monolith.
Before rejecting his idea, let's steelman it first.
A good debater can steelman the other side's view.
If you steelman their position, you'll understand the client better.

cards.def:
To present a problem from a different angle
हिंदी: समस्या को नए दृष्टिकोण से रखना
examples: Let me reframe the question: what happens when the vendor is late?
Try to reframe the failure as a chance to learn.
She reframed the cost as an investment in quality.
Let's reframe the problem from the customer's point of view.

cards.def:
To present or structure a problem in a particular way
हिंदी: समस्या को किसी रूप में प्रस्तुत करना
examples: How we frame this will affect which options we consider.
Frame your request around the benefit to the team.
The way you frame the question can change the answer.
He framed the delay as a choice to protect quality.

cards.def:
The reasoning behind a decision
हिंदी: तर्कसंगत आधार
examples: Could you share the rationale behind choosing this vendor?
Please write the rationale for this decision in the document.
The rationale for the price increase was rising costs.
I understand the decision, but I don't see the rationale.

cards.def:
A reason given to defend a decision
हिंदी: औचित्य
examples: We need stronger justification for the extra cost.
There's no justification for shouting at a colleague.
Please add a business justification to the budget request.
His only justification for the delay was a lack of time.

cards.def:
A statement that an argument is based on
हिंदी: तर्क की आधारभूत धारणा
examples: The premise that volume will double is questionable.
The whole plan rests on the premise that customers will pay more.
If the premise is wrong, the conclusion is wrong too.
The film's premise is simple: two strangers stuck in a lift.

cards.def:
An argument against a position
हिंदी: प्रतितर्क
examples: A strong counterargument is the added operational burden.
Prepare for the main counterargument before the debate.
His counterargument was that the project would cost too much.
Listen fully to a counterargument before you reply.

cards.def:
An expression of disagreement or concern
हिंदी: आपत्ति
examples: Does anyone have an objection to moving the release?
The neighbours raised an objection to the new building.
If there's no objection, we'll go ahead with Monday.
Her main objection was the lack of testing time.

cards.def:
A feeling of doubt about the outcome
हिंदी: मन में शंका
examples: I have misgivings about relying on a single vendor.
My parents had misgivings about me moving to another city.
Despite some misgivings, she accepted the job offer.
Share any misgivings now, not after we've started.

cards.def:
Having doubts about whether something is true or wise
हिंदी: संशयी
examples: I'm skeptical that we can finish this by Friday.
Customers are skeptical of offers that seem too good to be true.
I was skeptical at first, but the tool really saves time.
The investors remained skeptical about the growth numbers.

cards.def:
Having doubts (British spelling)
हिंदी: संशयी
examples: She was sceptical about the benchmark results.
Many people are sceptical about miracle diets.
I'm sceptical that a new tool alone will fix our process.
He was sceptical of the plan until he saw the results.

cards.def:
Possible and practical to do
हिंदी: व्यवहार्य
examples: Is it feasible to deliver this without extra people?
Working from home three days a week is feasible for our team.
Is it feasible to finish the course in a month?
We need a feasible plan, not a perfect one.

cards.def:
Reasonable and likely to be true
हिंदी: संभाव्य और विश्वसनीय
examples: A plausible explanation is that the cache was stale.
His excuse for being late sounded plausible.
It's plausible that the email went to spam.
The detective looked for the most plausible explanation.

cards.def:
Believable and trustworthy
हिंदी: विश्वसनीय
examples: We need a credible plan to recover the lost time.
The news came from a credible source.
To be credible, your estimate should include some buffer.
She is a credible speaker because she has done the work herself.

cards.def:
Strongly convincing
हिंदी: ज़ोरदार / प्रभावशाली
examples: The data makes a compelling case for change.
The book has a compelling story that kept me awake.
You need a compelling reason to change jobs so soon.
He gave a compelling demo that impressed the client.

cards.def:
Good at convincing others
हिंदी: प्रेरक / क़ायल करने वाला
examples: Her persuasive presentation won over the sceptics.
Be persuasive, but don't pressure the customer.
She wrote a persuasive email asking for a bigger budget.
His argument was more persuasive because he used real numbers.

cards.def:
Undecided between two options
हिंदी: दुविधा में होना
examples: I'm on the fence about adopting the new framework.
I'm on the fence about buying a car or using cabs.
The manager was on the fence, so we gave her more data.
I'm on the fence about the offer; the salary is good, but the commute is long.

cards.def:
An obvious problem that no one wants to discuss
हिंदी: वह बड़ी समस्या जिस पर कोई बात नहीं करता
examples: The elephant in the room is our lack of test coverage.
The elephant in the room was the layoffs nobody mentioned.
Let's address the elephant in the room: we're over budget.
At the family dinner, his job loss was the elephant in the room.

cards.def:
An issue no longer relevant or open to debate
हिंदी: अब अप्रासंगिक मुद्दा
examples: Whether to retry is a moot point; the vendor won't resend.
The ticket is already sold out, so it's a moot point.
Whether he should apply is a moot point now that he's got the job.
Arguing about the old design is a moot point after launch.

cards.def:
No longer available for consideration
हिंदी: विचार से बाहर
examples: A full rewrite is off the table this year.
Working from home is off the table during the audit week.
Once he shouted at the client, a promotion was off the table.
Is a salary increase completely off the table?

cards.def:
Available for consideration
हिंदी: विचाराधीन
examples: Two options are on the table at the moment.
Everything is on the table, including changing the vendor.
Let's put all the ideas on the table before we decide.
A remote role is still on the table if you're interested.

cards.def:
Starting again after a failure
हिंदी: फिर से शुरुआत करना
examples: The prototype failed, so it's back to the drawing board.
The client hated the logo, so it's back to the drawing board.
After the funding fell through, they went back to the drawing board.
One failed test doesn't mean back to the drawing board.

cards.def:
To spend too much time thinking or talking about something
हिंदी: किसी बात पर बहुत देर अटके रहना
examples: Let's not dwell on the past; let's fix the process.
Don't dwell on one bad interview; prepare for the next one.
He dwelt on the mistake for days.
Let's not dwell on details that don't change the decision.

cards.def:
To treat a matter too briefly or superficially
हिंदी: किसी बात को सरसरी तौर पर निपटाना
examples: We shouldn't gloss over the data-loss risk.
The report glossed over the safety problems.
Don't gloss over your weaknesses in the interview; explain how you're improving.
He glossed over the cost and talked only about benefits.

cards.def:
To avoid dealing with an issue
हिंदी: मुद्दे से बचना
examples: We can't sidestep the compliance question any longer.
The minister sidestepped the reporter's question.
She sidestepped the argument by changing the topic.
Sidestepping the problem will only make it bigger later.

cards.def:
To arrive at general agreement
हिंदी: आम सहमति पर पहुँचना
examples: We reached a consensus to postpone the migration.
The family reached a consensus on where to go for the holiday.
It took three meetings to reach a consensus on the budget.
If we can't reach a consensus, the manager will decide.

cards.def:
To decide after consideration
हिंदी: निर्णय पर पहुँचना
examples: We need to come to a decision by Thursday.
Take your time, but please come to a decision by Monday.
The committee came to a decision after a long debate.
We couldn't come to a decision without the cost numbers.

cards.def:
To present arguments in support of something
हिंदी: किसी पक्ष में तर्क देना
examples: She made a strong case for investing in automation.
I want to make a case for hiring one more tester.
He made a case for moving the office closer to the metro.
Use data to make a case for your promotion.

cards.def:
To mention a worry formally
हिंदी: चिंता उठाना
examples: I'd like to raise a concern about the rollback plan.
Several parents raised a concern about school fees.
If you raise a concern, suggest a solution too.
She raised a concern about the lack of training.

cards.def:
To express a view openly
हिंदी: राय व्यक्त करना
examples: Please voice your opinion before we finalise.
Everyone should feel safe to voice an opinion in this team.
He rarely voices an opinion in large meetings.
Feel free to voice an opinion, even if it's different.

cards.def:
To lead and steer a conversation
हिंदी: चर्चा का नेतृत्व करना
examples: She drove the discussion towards a clear decision.
Who will drive the discussion on next year's goals?
A good facilitator drives the discussion without dominating it.
He drove the discussion so well that we finished early.

cards.def:
To guide a discussion in a chosen direction
हिंदी: बातचीत को दिशा देना
examples: He steered the conversation back to the customer impact.
She steered the conversation away from office gossip.
Try to steer the conversation towards the client's needs.
When the call got heated, he steered the conversation to solutions.

cards.def:
To maintain focus and progress
हिंदी: चर्चा को पटरी पर रखना
examples: I'll keep the meeting on track and timeboxed.
Use a clear agenda to keep it on track.
The project had many changes, but she kept it on track.
If the call starts drifting, I'll gently keep it on track.

cards.def:
To postpone discussion of something (British: to bring forward)
हिंदी: चर्चा को स्थगित करना
examples: Let's table this until we have the cost estimate.
The committee tabled the proposal until next month.
We're short of time, so let's table the last agenda item.
The hiring discussion was tabled until the budget is final.

cards.def:
To postpone to a later time
हिंदी: आगे के लिए टालना
examples: We decided to defer the refactor to next quarter.
You can defer your exam to the next session.
The bank let me defer my loan payment for three months.
Let's defer this decision until the client confirms the scope.

cards.def:
To change the order of importance
हिंदी: प्राथमिकता फिर से तय करना
examples: We reprioritised after the client escalation.
After the budget cut, we had to reprioritise our goals.
Please reprioritise your tasks; the audit comes first now.
I reprioritise my to-do list every morning.

cards.def:
Agreement and support from stakeholders
हिंदी: हितधारकों का समर्थन
examples: We need leadership buy-in before we start.
Get buy-in from the team before changing the process.
Without buy-in from sales, the new tool won't be used.
She spent weeks building buy-in for the idea.

cards.def:
To strongly support and promote an idea
हिंदी: किसी विचार को बढ़ावा देना
examples: She championed the move to infrastructure as code.
He championed flexible working hours for new parents.
We need someone senior to champion this project.
She has always championed women in engineering.

cards.def:
To spur people into action
हिंदी: कार्रवाई के लिए प्रेरित करना
examples: The outage galvanised the company to invest in resilience.
The flood galvanised the whole neighbourhood to help.
Her speech galvanised the team before the big launch.
The new competitor galvanised us to improve our app.

cards.def:
To organise resources or people for action
हिंदी: संसाधनों/लोगों को जुटाना
examples: We mobilised three teams to fix the data issue.
The NGO mobilised hundreds of volunteers after the cyclone.
We need to mobilise the support team before the sale starts.
The company mobilised funds quickly to open the new branch.

cards.def:
To bring into agreement or proper position
हिंदी: तालमेल बिठाना
examples: We should align on priorities before the planning session.
Make sure your goals align with the team's goals.
Let's align with marketing on the launch date.
Her values aligned well with the company culture.

cards.def:
Based on personal opinion or feelings
हिंदी: व्यक्तिपरक
examples: Code readability is partly subjective.
Taste is subjective; some people love spicy food.
Performance reviews should not be too subjective.
Whether the design looks modern is subjective.

cards.def:
Showing unfair preference
हिंदी: पक्षपाती
examples: Our estimate is biased towards optimistic outcomes.
The survey was biased because it asked only happy customers.
Try not to be biased towards candidates from your own college.
The news channel gave a biased report of the event.

cards.def:
Treating all sides equally
हिंदी: निष्पक्ष
examples: We need an impartial review of both options.
A judge must remain impartial.
We asked an impartial colleague to review both proposals.
The referee was impartial and fair to both teams.

cards.def:
Willing to consider new ideas
हिंदी: खुले विचारों वाला
examples: Please be open-minded about the alternative design.
Travelling has made me more open-minded about food.
An open-minded manager listens to new ideas from juniors.
Stay open-minded during the interview; the role may surprise you.

cards.def:
Willing to consider and accept ideas
हिंदी: ग्रहणशील
examples: The team was receptive to the new process.
The manager was receptive to my idea of flexible hours.
Customers were receptive to the new menu.
Be receptive to feedback, even when it's hard to hear.

cards.def:
Overly protective of oneself against criticism
हिंदी: रक्षात्मक
examples: Don't get defensive; it's feedback on the code, not you.
He became defensive when I asked about the missed deadline.
Being defensive makes it hard for others to give you feedback.
Her tone was defensive, so I softened my questions.

cards.def:
Helpful and intended to improve
हिंदी: रचनात्मक
examples: She offered constructive feedback on my design.
The meeting was constructive, and we agreed on next steps.
Give constructive criticism with a suggestion for improvement.
Let's keep the discussion constructive and avoid blaming anyone.

cards.def:
Honest and direct
हिंदी: स्पष्टवादी
examples: I appreciate your candid feedback.
To be candid, I don't think the plan will work.
She gave a candid interview about her career struggles.
I like working with him because he is candid and fair.

cards.def:
Careful not to offend others
हिंदी: व्यवहारकुशल
examples: He was tactful when pointing out the mistake.
Be tactful when you tell a colleague their idea won't work.
She gave a tactful reply to a very rude email.
A tactful manager praises in public and corrects in private.

cards.def:
Skilled at handling sensitive situations
हिंदी: कूटनीतिक / चतुर
examples: Her diplomatic response defused the tension.
He gave a diplomatic answer to avoid taking sides.
Be diplomatic when you discuss salary with your manager.
The diplomatic way to decline is to thank them first.

cards.def:
Confident and direct without being aggressive
हिंदी: दृढ़ पर विनम्र
examples: Be assertive about the risks without sounding aggressive.
Be assertive and ask for the raise you deserve.
She was assertive but polite with the rude customer.
Assertive people say no without feeling guilty.

cards.def:
Logical and consistent
हिंदी: सुसंगत
examples: Your argument is clear and coherent.
The essay was short but coherent.
Let's write a coherent plan instead of a list of ideas.
After the long flight, I was too tired to speak in coherent sentences.

cards.def:
Clear, logical and convincing
हिंदी: ठोस और तर्कसंगत
examples: She made a cogent argument for refactoring now.
The lawyer presented a cogent case to the judge.
He gave cogent reasons for changing the vendor.
Her cogent summary convinced the board.

cards.def:
Clearly expressed and easy to understand
हिंदी: स्पष्ट और सुबोध
examples: His lucid explanation helped the whole team.
The book gives a lucid explanation of how money works.
Even late at night, his emails were lucid and clear.
Make your slides lucid so anyone can follow them.

cards.def:
Not clearly expressed or defined
हिंदी: अस्पष्ट
examples: The requirements are too vague to estimate.
His answer was vague, so I asked for a date.
Vague goals like do better are hard to measure.
I have only a vague memory of that meeting.

cards.def:
Open to more than one interpretation
हिंदी: दो अर्थ वाला
examples: The ambiguous wording led to confusion.
The sign was ambiguous, so many drivers took the wrong turn.
Avoid ambiguous words like soon in your emails.
Her reply was ambiguous; I couldn't tell if she agreed.

cards.def:
Stated clearly and in detail
हिंदी: स्पष्ट रूप से कहा गया
examples: Please be explicit about who owns each task.
The rules are explicit: no phones in the exam hall.
Be explicit about the deadline, not just say early next week.
He gave explicit instructions for the handover.

cards.def:
Implied but not directly stated
हिंदी: अप्रत्यक्ष / निहित
examples: There's an implicit assumption that data arrives on time.
There was an implicit agreement that seniors would mentor juniors.
Trust is implicit in a good team.
Make the implicit rules of the team written and clear.

cards.def:
A digression from the main topic
हिंदी: विषय से भटकाव
examples: We went off on a tangent about tooling.
The teacher went off on a tangent about her college days.
Sorry, that was a tangent; back to the budget.
Long tangents make meetings run over time.

cards.def:
To leave the main subject temporarily
हिंदी: मुख्य विषय से भटकना
examples: Sorry to digress, but this relates to our earlier issue.
Let me digress for a moment to tell you a quick story.
He tends to digress when he's nervous.
Try not to digress during a short presentation.

cards.def:
Long, unfocused and confusing
हिंदी: बेतरतीब और लंबा
examples: The rambling update lost the audience.
She sent a rambling email that nobody fully read.
His rambling answer didn't impress the interviewer.
The speech was rambling and went on for an hour.

cards.def:
Using more words than necessary
हिंदी: शब्दों की भरमार वाला
examples: The documentation is too verbose to be useful.
Your cover letter is too verbose; cut it to half a page.
Verbose code comments can hide the important points.
He is verbose in emails but quiet in meetings.

cards.def:
Using very few words, sometimes abruptly
हिंदी: बहुत संक्षिप्त / रूखा
examples: His terse reply felt dismissive.
The manager sent a terse message: see me now.
Her terse answers made the interview awkward.
A terse reply can look rude in a chat message.

cards.def:
Direct to the point of being rude
हिंदी: रूखा-सूखा स्पष्ट
examples: I'll be blunt: this design won't scale.
My friend was blunt and said the dress didn't suit me.
Being blunt with clients can damage the relationship.
To be blunt, we're not ready for the launch.

cards.def:
Not certain or final
हिंदी: अस्थायी / संकोची
examples: This is a tentative plan pending approval.
We've made a tentative booking for the hall.
She gave a tentative yes to the job offer.
Our tentative plan is to travel in December.

cards.def:
Arranged for now but likely to change
हिंदी: अनंतिम
examples: We've set a provisional release date for March.
You have provisional admission until your documents are verified.
The provisional figures will be updated next week.
He has a provisional driving licence for now.

cards.def:
Final and authoritative
हिंदी: निर्णायक
examples: We don't yet have a definitive answer on cost.
This book is the definitive guide to Indian cooking.
We'll send a definitive schedule once the venue confirms.
There is no definitive answer to this question yet.

cards.def:
Decisive and settling a question
हिंदी: निर्णायक रूप से प्रमाणित करने वाला
examples: The test results were not conclusive.
The CCTV footage was conclusive proof of the theft.
There's no conclusive evidence that the update caused the crash.
We need conclusive data before changing the pricing.

cards.def:
Not leading to a firm result
हिंदी: अनिर्णायक
examples: The investigation was inconclusive.
The meeting was inconclusive, so we'll meet again on Monday.
Early tests of the medicine were inconclusive.
The A/B test was inconclusive because too few users saw it.

cards.def:
Used to admit a point before giving a contrast
हिंदी: माना कि / ठीक है कि
examples: Granted, the fix is quick, but is it safe?
Granted, the rent is high, but the location is excellent.
Granted, he was late, but his work was excellent.
Granted, it's a small team, but they deliver a lot.

cards.def:
Adding a point that is not central
हिंदी: संयोग से / प्रसंगवश
examples: Incidentally, that library is deprecated.
Incidentally, I met your old manager at the conference.
Incidentally, the office will close early on Friday.
We discussed the budget and, incidentally, the new hire.

cards.def:
A brief statement of your opinion
हिंदी: संक्षेप में मेरी राय
examples: In a nutshell, my view is that we should wait.
In a nutshell, my view is that the price is too high.
In a nutshell, my view is that we need more testers.
In a nutshell, my view is that she's ready for promotion.
